title: Chitosan functionalized nitrogen-doped carbon dot nanocomposites: a turn-on sensor for fluoride detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34094-34104
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04745E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sujal, Raj Singh, Suman Swami, Shikha Bhogal
Chitosan-functionalized nitrogen-doped carbon dots (N-CDs@C) were synthesised as an environmentally-friendly fluorescence probe. N-CDs@C was employed as “turn-on” sensor for the detection of fluoride anion.
